question: Which exact-target firmware functions implement named interconnect and the direct THIRDPARTY_APP watch-to-phone submission path?
prototype_hypothesis: interconnect_connect(loop, conn, name, cb) registers a named client; interconnect_send queues named-transport data; thirdparty_submit_message_content(content) synchronously accepts a caller-built 336-byte THIRDPARTY_APP envelope without repeating wearable appinfo lookup; quickapp_register_app is not routing-only registration.
callsite_evidence: sub_C2D2034 stores the callback and node in caller-owned conn storage and connects to miwear-server
sub_C2D20C4 dispatches client mode through sub_C2D1D7C and the stock JS caller passes caller-owned conn with NULL name
sub_C5289A8 quickapp_send_wearmsg resolves package appinfo through sub_C528F5C before it constructs or submits a phone message
after lookup, sub_C5289A8 zeroes exactly 336 bytes, writes message_id 0x160914, kind 9, and pointers at +0x10/+0x14/+0x18
the payload pointer references [u16 byte length][payload]; stock frees it immediately after sub_CA8B0BC returns
sub_CA8B0BC returns -22 for null, places a non-null envelope in a lower dispatch descriptor, calls loc_CA8AC1C, and returns 0 without appinfo lookup
sub_C527E38 performs full quick-app registration and also changes page/app/launcher lifecycle state
control_flow_evidence: named proxy routing depends on wearable appinfo, so using com.xiaomi.miwear.interconnect as a non-installed named client does not create a route
stock outbound path sub_C5289A8 -> sub_CA8B0BC -> loc_CA8AC1C identifies the lower direct submission boundary
direct submit bypasses the wrapper's appinfo lookup while retaining the stock lower serializer and transport
NULL fingerprint represents an omitted optional protobuf field; direct submit acceptance is not final phone delivery
ownership_analysis: Named conn and asynchronous message ownership follow the connection framework. The direct-submit 336-byte envelope and referenced package/payload are borrowed synchronously; stock frees payload immediately after return.
unsafe_assumptions: STATIC_RECOVERED: exact signature and layout recovered from IDA; device probe pending
phone-to-watch replies through the named receive connection remain probe-pending
recommended_probe: Submit a tagged payload directly with com.xiaomi.miwear.interconnect and NULL fingerprint; verify phone core MessageContent, plugin delivery, and reply reception separately.
